senses.gloss: c. (= b. h. חֹטֶר, v. חֲטַר; cmp. גִּזְרָא I) staff, scepter.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 45:7">Targ. Ps. XLV, 7</cite>; a. fr. [Also <cite ref="H00645"><he>חֹטֶר</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00304"><he>חֻטְרָא</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="H00644"><he>חֲטַר</he></cite>.].—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53">Gen. R. s. 53</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00735"><he>זְרַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>ח׳ ותרתין וכ׳</he> the (old man’s) staff and two feet.

<cite ref="Shabbat 109b:8">Sabb. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ דרעיא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>יחידאה</he>) the Shepherd’s Staff (the Lonely Staff), name of a plant, v. <cite ref="H00378"><he>חוּמְטַרְיָא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:4:5">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᵇ</cite> top, a. e., v. <cite ref="M02898"><he>מַשְׁכּוֹכִית</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חוּטְרִין</he>, <cite ref="H00305"><he>חוּטְרַיָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 30:37">Targ. Gen. XXX, 37</cite>; a. fr.
